newsitem.title: USA: Garden Botanika May same-store sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Garden Botanika May same-store sales rise.

text.p: Garden Botanika Inc said Wednesday same-store sales rose 11 percent in the four weeks ended May 31 compared with the year-ago period.
Overall sales increased 58 percent to $8.72 million from $5.52 million in May 1996. Total store sales increased 63 percent as the number of stores increased to 264 from 167.
Mail order sales increased 8 percent from the prior May.
For the 17 weeks ended May 31, 1997, overall sales increased 47 percent to $32.64 million from $22.17 million in the comparable period last year.
Year to date, total store sales increased 57 percent. Comparable store sales increased four percent in the 1997 period. Mail-order sales declined 20 percent year to date.
